description: List creatives in an ad account (read-only), so you can see what can be reused. Reads every page; a note says when the list is cut.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (set by setup). snap_ping shows the current one.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Lower it for a shorter answer; the answer says if more exist.

name_contains.description: Only items whose name contains this text (case-insensitive). Use it to find one item in a big account.

offset.description: Skip this many rows (for the next page, use next_offset from the previous answer).

response_format.description: concise = only id, name and status; detailed = every field.

name: snap_list_creatives
